head: codex/5350-v0918-wp11-shadow-parity
title: [v0.91.8][WP-11] Prove exact ADL v1/v2 shadow parity
body:
Closes #5350

Adds a bounded exact-revision shadow harness over the immutable 25-case ADL v1 characterization corpus and the installed ADL v2 candidate. It executes each mapped case three times, retains 75+75 observations and 23 behavior rows, enforces both equivalence groups and the sequential-order difference, and classifies every replacement difference with explicit authority, risk, proof, and rollback.

The same report binds all ten Runtime v3 parity groups, both adapter issues, and WP-10A live evidence without granting cutover, default-selector, or product authority. Receipts remain audit evidence rather than downstream execution blockers, and truthful squash integration is accepted by exact PR identity.

Validation: 35/35 focused tests, strict all-target Clippy, fmt/diff hygiene, deterministic byte-identical full rerun, zero blockers, and one GPT-5.5 exact-revision review cycle. The review found four issues, including an ordering-group P1; all four are fixed and the exact fix-head re-review is PASS with no findings. No AWS or network-capable shadow command is used.
